known_differences.description: GMRES uses adaptive inner restart tolerance and LGMRES guards against k=0 lucky breakdown.

threats.description: GMRES stagnation across restarts when inner Krylov tolerance is loose relative to outer residual norm.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-sparse/src/linalg.rs:9480 (gmres): tightens inner Arnoldi tolerance adaptively across restarts and verifies true residual ||b - Ax||.
threats.strict_mode_response: Run restarted GMRES with true-residual check and return converged flag matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite matrix or RHS inputs fail-closed and record audit event.

threats.description: Corrupted CSR/CSC indptr or out-of-bounds column/row indices passed to sparse constructors or solvers.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-sparse/src/linalg.rs:5861 (spsolve): validates sparse structure invariants, square dimensions, and RHS length before factorization.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(SparseError) on structural or shape mismatch.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject malformed structure fail-closed and emit AuditAction::FailClosed.

threats.description: LGMRES lucky breakdown at k=0 or non-convergent Krylov iterations spinning indefinitely.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-sparse/src/linalg.rs:9867 (lgmres): detects happy breakdown in Arnoldi step and enforces outer maxiter cap.
threats.strict_mode_response: Terminate cleanly on breakdown or maxiter limit.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce iteration cap and emit structured convergence diagnostics.

threats.description: Negative-weight cycles in shortest-path graph algorithms or disconnected graph components.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-sparse/src/linalg.rs:38974 (dijkstra): rejects negative edge weights in Dijkstra and delegates signed graphs to Bellman-Ford.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return SparseError on negative edge weight in Dijkstra matching SciPy csgraph.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate graph adjacency finiteness and symmetry invariants.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject fail-closed and record AuditAction::FailClosed in ledger.
Return SparseError::SingularMatrix or fallback via SparseSolverPortfolio.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Reject when check_finite or Hardened mode is active.
